title: One Publish control in the browser: the bound remote on Health, no URL typing per goal, docs and the UnAI live push
description:

Verify children on disk first: `grep -n "remote/read" apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-read-dispatch.ts`; `grep -n "PUBLISH_REMOTE_UNBOUND" apps/daemon/src -r`.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the human-visible end - control room, Playwright, docs, and the live push on UnAI. No daemon production change.

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/goal-publish.tsx (134 lines): `REMOTE_STORAGE_KEY = "moe.publish.remoteUrl"` (:18) read/written through localStorage (:29, :35-37), `remoteUrl` state (:66), `canPublish` requires a typed URL (:73), `port.submit(offer, goalId, remoteUrl)` (:78), testids cr.publish.root/landed/state/link (:88-97); publish-port.ts:14-20 `submit(affordance, goalId, remoteUrl)` spends the offer with payload {goalId, remoteUrl}. After child 1 the payload's remoteUrl may be null (bound remote) and the bound remote is served by `POST /repository/remote/read` (its live decoder lands with child 1).
- Health screen: apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/ops-screens.tsx:180-206 `HealthScreen` (cr.health.root/banner/facts/verifier) - the project-level home for a "Repository" card; live-ops.tsx wires the ops reads.
- Board header publish link keys on the offer (memory board-screen-landed-2026-09-04); after child 2 the offer exists only with a landed commit, so a goal with nothing landed renders no publish card at all.
- Docs: docs/agent-stack-runbook.md '### Publishing (your decision, your remote)' (:402-420: "type the git remote ... and confirm"); README.md publish clause (:54-55 "the publisher pushes only when a human names a remote on the goal").
- Live lane: UnAI (D:/projexts/UnAI), scripts/up.ps1; the owner's remote for UnAI is named by the owner at drive time (never invented).

FEATURE: the publish card becomes ONE control: when a remote is bound it shows "Publish to <remote>" with the landed commits it will push (from /runs/read landing) and a Publish arm/confirm sending {goalId, remoteUrl: null}; when no remote is bound it shows the URL input once (first binding) and sends {goalId, remoteUrl: <typed>}; a Change link on the card and on Health reveals the input again (the next publish rebinds); `moe.publish.remoteUrl` localStorage is gone; with nothing landed the card renders nothing. Health gains a "Repository" card: the bound remote (or "no remote bound - bind it from a goal's Publish card"), boundAt/boundBy, Change. README + runbook rewritten to the project shape.
definitionOfDone: goal-publish tests: bound remote -> no URL input, the card names the remote and the landed commits, Publish dispatches {goalId, remoteUrl: null} (payload asserted byte-exact through publish-port.ts); unbound -> the input renders once and Publish dispatches {goalId, remoteUrl: <typed>}; Change reveals the input while bound; nothing landed (no offer) -> the card renders nothing; `grep -rn "moe.publish.remoteUrl" apps/control-room/src` = 0 and no localStorage read/write remains in goal-publish.tsx.

Health screen test: the Repository card renders the bound remote + boundAt/boundBy from the real `/repository/remote/read` frame (recorded from a real daemon), the unbound wording when null, and the Change control; the ops read roster/poller test updated (live-ops.tsx).

Playwright journey against a REAL daemon (tests/e2e/control-room/): land a commit -> Publish card appears -> first publish types the URL (a local bare repository as the remote) -> the receipt link renders -> second goal publishes with no typing; `pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted.

Live drive on UnAI: the owner's remote bound by the first publish from the browser, the `moe-publish-receipt/1` PUSHED line with the remote branch link, then a second publish with no URL typed - receipt ids + links in a row comment (a refused push recorded verbatim, never worked around).

docs/agent-stack-runbook.md Publishing section and README publish clause rewritten to the project shape in the same commit; gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:e2e:browser`; every production file touched stays under 250 lines (`wc -l` quoted); sources ASCII-only, JSX text apostrophe-free.
taskRails: NO DAEMON PRODUCTION CHANGE: a daemon gap belongs to child 1 or 2 - stop, comment there, report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds.
REAL FRAMES ONLY: control-room fixtures are recorded from a real daemon (exact-key decoders); the remote URL in the live drive is the owner's, never invented, and never carries a credential.
Test ids keep the cr.publish.* / cr.health.* prefixes; sources ASCII-only, JSX text without apostrophes (package-boundary scan). <=250 lines per production source.

DECISION RECORDED: the card returns null when `offer === null && publish === null`. THE CARD states only what /repository/remote/read answered: `cr.health.repository.remote` (the url, or the unbound sentence), `cr.health.repository.facts` with `.boundat`/`.boundby`, `cr.health.repository.change`, `.loading` while unanswered, `.refusal` carrying the daemon own code AND layer. CHANGE ON HEALTH IS A SIGNPOST, NOT A REBIND, and I want that on the record. The binding is an EFFECT of `repository.publish`; Health holds no publish offer, so a Change button here has no command behind it. Pressing it reveals `cr.health.repository.changehow`, which names where the rebind actually happens (the Publish card on any goal with landed work). A button that pretended to change the remote from this screen would be a control with nothing behind it - the same class of lie as a fabricated green.

implementationPlan.note:
NEW REAL-DAEMON JOURNEY LANDED, AND ONE HALF OF DoD 3 IS NOT REACHABLE - measured, disclosed, not simulated.

THE GAP, WITH THE MEASUREMENT. DoD 3 asks the journey to "land a commit". A landing receipt is written ONLY by apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/node-lander.ts under command kind `internal.repository.landing_receipt` (landing-receipt-contracts.ts:22). That kind has NO HTTP ingress: `grep -n record_landing apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts` = 0 hits, so it is absent from PAYLOAD_KEYS and neither a browser nor a spec-side fetch can author one. `grep -rn "recordLandingReceipt|landing" apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed*.ts` = 0: the shipped seed never calls the lander either. Child 2 (ebca5210) made the publish offer conditional on a landed commit, so with the seed as it is TODAY no e2e lane can make a `repository.publish` offer appear. Driving a real first publish in the browser needs a LANDING LANE built first (a real wrapper delivering + accepting + committing into a scratch repository) - new lane infrastructure, not a spec. Task rail 1 forbids me the daemon change that would open an ingress. I did not fake it: the live drive (step 6) is where a real publish is exercised.

WHAT I BUILT INSTEAD, all of it real and reachable: tests/e2e/control-room/publish-remote.spec.ts (161 lines), one browser, one spawned daemon, the SHIPPED seed, the operator's real pairing ritual. It proves:
1. `/repository/remote/read` REACHES THE DAEMON FROM THE PAGE, through the dev proxy - i.e. step 2's proxy pin, EXECUTED.
2. UNBOUND IS A STATE: the exact five-key REMOTE frame, all three bound fields null, and the Repository card on Health saying so rather than refusing.
3. NOTHING LANDED -> NO CARD against the daemon's real ladder: `cr.publish.root/.button/.remote` all count 0 in a real browser.
4. Change on Health reveals where the rebind happens.

FIXTURE CAPTURED FROM THAT RUN (task rail 2). The lane printed its own frame:
  [publish-remote] daemon pid 50712 at http://127.0.0.1:56036; unbound frame {"boundAt":null,"boundBy":null,"outcome":"REMOTE","readAt":"2026-09-05T01:52:58.755Z","remoteUrl":null}
Byte-identical in shape and key ORDER to the UNBOUND fixture I recorded off the production port in step 2 and use in live-repository-remote.test.ts, goal-publish.test.tsx and ops-screens.test.tsx. The unit fixtures are now confirmed against a real daemon over real HTTP.
